The mediator is a construct measured by several indicators, and you want its
indirect effect without first averaging the indicators into a score. Part of the
[Models](models.html) collection; the second of four
[native engine](model-native.html) pages. The engine is experimental.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Structure** | X to a latent mediator $\eta$ (with indicators) to Y |
| **Class returned** | `SEMFit`, then `MediationData` |
| **Syntax** | `eta =~ m1 + m2 + m3` defines the latent variable |
| **Indirect effect** | $a \, b$ through the latent $\eta$ |

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(medfit)
library(generics)
```

## Simulated data

The mediator `eta` is not a column of the data. Three noisy indicators measure it,
and the true indirect effect is $0.5 \times 0.4 = 0.2$.

```{r}
#| label: data
set.seed(11)
n <- 400
X <- rnorm(n)
eta <- 0.5 * X + rnorm(n, sd = 0.9)
ldat <- data.frame(
  X = X,
  m1 = eta + rnorm(n, sd = 0.7),
  m2 = 0.8 * eta + rnorm(n, sd = 0.7),
  m3 = 0.7 * eta + rnorm(n, sd = 0.8)
)
ldat$Y <- 0.4 * eta + 0.2 * X + rnorm(n, sd = 0.8)
```

## Fit it

```{r}
#| label: fit
syntax <- "
  eta =~ m1 + m2 + m3
  eta ~ a * X
  Y ~ b * eta + cp * X
  ab := a * b
"
fit <- fit_sem(syntax, ldat)
summary(fit)
```

The first indicator's loading is fixed at 1 to set the scale of `eta`, so the
table lists loadings only for `m2` and `m3`.

```{r}
#| label: extract
x <- extract_mediation(fit, treatment = "X", mediator = "eta", outcome = "Y")
tidy(x, type = "effects", conf.int = TRUE)
```

## Why not average the indicators

An average of the indicators contains measurement error, which pulls the
indirect effect toward zero. In this simulation:

```{r}
#| label: average
ldat$M_avg <- rowMeans(ldat[, c("m1", "m2", "m3")])
avg <- fit_mediation(Y ~ X + M_avg, M_avg ~ X, data = ldat,
                     treatment = "X", mediator = "M_avg")
c(latent = unname(nie(x)), average_of_indicators = unname(nie(avg)), truth = 0.2)
```

One simulated dataset shows the direction, not the size of the difference.

## Limits

- **The variables in the syntax must be columns of the data**, except the latent
  ones. A variable that is missing stops the fit with "variables in the model are
  not columns of `data`".
- **One latent mediator per `fit_mediation(engine = "native")` call**, as with
  any single mediator; for several, use `fit_sem()` and
  [extract](model-native-multi.html) the structure.
- **Experimental.** The syntax and the printed diagnostics may change before the
  engine is stable.
